name: Markdown Plugin UI
description: Markdown viewer DOM and interactions. Documents the editor-wrap layout, tab bar with scrollable tab container, markdown preview pane, tab interactions (switch, close, drag-reorder, context menu, middle-click close), file load/render/external-reload flows, and visual states for empty, loaded, error, and file-deleted conditions.

dom.root: .editor-wrap (this.el) — flex column layout wrapping tab bar and preview pane

elements.editor_tab_bar: .editor-tab-bar (this.bar) — horizontal tab strip bar containing the scrollable tab container
elements.editor_tab_scroll: .editor-tab-scroll (this.tabContainer) — overflow-x auto scroll container for tabs, with auto-scroll to keep active tab visible via scrollIntoView
elements.md_preview: .md-preview (this.preview) — scrollable preview pane where rendered markdown content is displayed. Wheel events have stopPropagation to prevent canvas zoom.

tab_structure.container: .editor-tab — per-tab div, set draggable=true for drag-and-drop reorder, title attribute set to full filePath
tab_structure.name_span: .editor-tab-name — span displaying the file name (no path)
tab_structure.close_btn: .editor-tab-close — span showing '✕' character, click handler with e.stopPropagation()

states.active: .is-active — applied when this tab is the currently active tab (tab.filePath === this.activeTab)
states.dragging: .is-dragging — applied to the source tab during dragstart, removed on document-level dragend listener
states.dragover: .is-dragover — applied to a potential drop target tab on dragenter, removed on dragleave or drop

interactions.name: load_file
interactions.trigger: FileExplorer 'Open to Markdown' context menu action or canvas-area direct call
interactions.action: Normalize path (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercased for key) → check if tab with lcPath already exists → if exists: switchTab(lcPath); if new: read file content via IPC fs:readFile → push { filePath: lcPath, name } to tabs → initialize scrollTops[lcPath] = 0 → switchTab(lcPath)
interactions.result: New tab appears in tab bar with markdown content rendered in preview pane

interactions.name: switch_tab
interactions.action: Save current scroll position: scrollTops[activeTab] = preview.scrollTop → update activeTab to lcPath → reloadFile(lcPath) via IPC fs:readFile → restore scrollTops[lcPath] on preview → renderTabs()
interactions.result: Preview content switches to selected tab's file, scroll position restored, tab bar reflects new active state

interactions.name: close_tab
interactions.trigger: Click on .editor-tab-close span or middle-click (button === 1) on .editor-tab
interactions.action: Remove tab from tabs array splice → delete from scrollTops map → if closed tab was active: neighbor fallback (Math.min(idx, tabs.length - 1)) or show 'No file loaded' if no tabs remain → renderTabs()
interactions.propagation: Close button click handler calls e.stopPropagation() to prevent switch_tab from also firing
interactions.result: Tab removed from bar; if it was active, preview switches to adjacent tab or shows empty state

interactions.name: drag_reorder
interactions.trigger: dragstart on source .editor-tab → dragenter/dragover/dragleave/drop on target .editor-tab
interactions.gesture: dragstart: e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', tab.filePath), add .is-dragging class → dragover: e.preventDefault() → dragenter: e.preventDefault(), add .is-dragover class → dragleave: remove .is-dragover class → drop: e.preventDefault(), remove .is-dragover, read draggedPath from dataTransfer, splice tab from fromIdx to toIdx in tabs array → renderTabs()
interactions.result: Tabs reordered in tab bar to match new tabs array order; active tab selection preserved

interactions.name: context_menu
interactions.action: e.preventDefault() and e.stopPropagation() → new ContextMenu([{Close: closeTab}, {Close Others: closeOtherTabs}, {Close All: closeAllTabs}, {separator}, {Copy File Path: clipboard.writeText(filePath)}], e.clientX, e.clientY)
interactions.result: Floating context menu appears at click position with tab management actions

interactions.name: external_change
interactions.trigger: fs.onChanged callback from preload (registered in constructor as this.unsubFileChanged)
interactions.action: Normalize rawPath (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercased) → find matching tab by filePath or filename match → save previous scroll → reloadFile(lcPath) via IPC fs:readFile → if activeTab matches, restore previous scroll position on preview
interactions.result: External file changes reflected in preview; scroll position preserved for active tab

interactions.name: wheel_stop
interactions.action: e.stopPropagation() with { passive: true } listener — prevents wheel event from reaching canvas for zoom, allows natural scroll within preview pane
interactions.result: Preview scrolls independently without triggering canvas zoom

interactions.name: close_others
interactions.trigger: 'Close Others' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: Keep only the right-clicked tab → set tabs = [keptTab] → preserve only that tab's scrollTop → set activeTab = keptTab → renderTabs() → restore preview scrollTop
interactions.result: All tabs except the context-clicked one are removed from bar

interactions.name: close_all
interactions.trigger: 'Close All' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: Clear all state: tabs = [], scrollTops = {}, activeTab = null → preview.innerHTML = 'No file loaded' → renderTabs()
interactions.result: All tabs removed, preview shows empty state

interactions.name: copy_file_path
interactions.trigger: 'Copy File Path' in tab right-click context menu
interactions.action: IPC clipboard.writeText(tab.filePath) — copies the full lowercased file path to system clipboard
interactions.result: File path copied to system clipboard

states.empty: tabs.length === 0, activeTab === null. Tab container shows .editor-empty span 'No file loaded'. Preview shows .md-status div 'No file loaded'.
states.loaded: One or more tabs in tabs array. Tab bar shows .editor-tab elements. Active tab marked with .is-active class. Preview displays rendered markdown HTML wrapped in .md-content div, with escaped raw HTML and stripped javascript: links for XSS prevention.
states.error: marked.parse() threw an exception or returned unexpected result. Preview shows .md-status.is-error div 'Render error'.
states.file_deleted: External file change detected (via fs.onChanged) and file no longer exists on disk. Preview shows .md-status div 'File deleted'.

rendering.tab_scroll: Active tab auto-scrolled into view via scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' }) on the .is-active element after renderTabs()
rendering.markdown_renderer: Custom marked Renderer: html() escapes < and > characters; link() strips javascript: protocol hrefs (renders as span instead of anchor). marked.parse() called with breaks: true for line-break support
rendering.preview_wrapper: Rendered HTML wrapped in .md-content div via styleMarkdown() method. Empty files show .md-status div 'Empty file'.

security.xss_prevention: Raw HTML in markdown is escaped: < → < and > → > via custom marked Renderer.html override. javascript: protocol links are stripped via custom Renderer.link override (renders span without href). This prevents XSS from malicious .md files.

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card termination → MarkdownPlugin.destroy() unsubscribes file watcher, then PluginCard removes DOM
